title: Stage-3 mechanical convention-conformance gate outcome
description: The versioned machine-readable verdict emitted by conformance_gate.evaluate_task for one edit task. Deterministic and byte-stable: anchors are ordered by (path, lines) and reason codes are drawn from a stable enum. FAILS CLOSED -- any abnormal condition (missing/decoy/non-live anchor, stale bound, absent identifier, ambiguous or absent structural match, malformed/unsupported rule, tool failure) yields passed=false with the exact reason code.

rule_id.description: The convention rule id; null when the rule was malformed.

kind.description: The structural handler family that judged the rule; null when unsupported/malformed.

passed.description: True only when every anchor conforms.

diagnostic.description: Human-readable summary; leads with the first failing reason code.

reason.description: Stable reason-code enum. CONFORMS is the only passing code; every other code is a fail-closed condition.

evidence.description: The matched conforming construct, or '' when none matched.
